title: LinkedIn Added a New Way to Report AI Slop - CNET
summary: Allowing people to report posts that seem like AI slop will help LinkedIn get better at spotting the AI-created, low-quality content. “Slop is hard to define and the definition changes; this lets us tune our models and make better feeds,” Srinivasan said.
